found.truth_sql: SELECT b, countIf(t > toDateTime(0, 'UTC') AND t <= e) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT toStartOfQuarter(d) AS b, addSeconds(toDateTime(toStartOfQuarter(d) + INTERVAL 1 QUARTER, 'UTC'), -1) AS e FROM (SELECT toDate('2025-04-01') + toIntervalDay(number) AS d FROM numbers(toUInt64(dateDiff('day', toDate('2025-04-01'), toDate('2025-10-01')))))) AS s CROSS JOIN (SELECT toTimeZone(o.created_at, 'UTC') AS t, toNullable(o.amount) AS amt FROM shop.orders o LEFT JOIN shop.users u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN shop.products p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE (toString(o.status) IN ('no such')) UNION ALL SELECT toDateTime(0, 'UTC'), CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(Decimal(12, 2))')) AS r GROUP BY b SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
